conditions.evidence: Sleep deprivation (SD) is associated with decreased cognitive performance
conditions.label: sleep deprivation

modalities.evidence: functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) measurements were carried out
assessment of cognitive performance with the aid of Cambridge Neuropsychological Test Automated Battery (CANTAB)

output.population: Ten young healthy adults (males, age of 27.6±3.7 years, one left-handed participant) recruited in 2018 at University of Oklahoma, Translational Geroscience Laboratory
output.summary: fNIRS recordings of frontal-lobe hemodynamics at rest and during a finger-tapping task, plus CANTAB cognitive testing, in young healthy adults before and after 24-hour sleep deprivation.
